correctness.summary: Degree-sum inequalities give the exact lower bound; a staircase/majorization construction satisfies Gale-Ryser at equality. A component-merging 2-switch proves connected realizability when the sharp positive degree sequences have at least n-1 edges, which holds for every a>=2. The a=1 connected obstruction is structural.

limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge; unindexed or differently phrased equivalent results may exist.
The result concerns consecutive positive distributed degree sets [a] and [b], not arbitrary unequal-cardinality sets.
The equal-cardinality specialization is covered by earlier literature and is included only for a unified statement.
Finite verification supports but does not replace the proof.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The checked 2014 literature treats equal-cardinality distributed degree sets and identifies the unequal-cardinality minimum-order direction as open; the 2015 arbitrary-cardinality result establishes existence but notes its construction is usually larger. No equivalent exact theorem for consecutive sets [a],[b] or its connected classification was found in targeted searches or current SCOPE records.

review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.

value.summary: The theorem gives an exact closed-form minimum for an infinite unequal-cardinality family, proves that the same minimum is connectedly attainable throughout the feasible range, and identifies the complete infinite connected obstruction family when one side has degree set [1].
